prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium light theme full viewport decorative background for EDY CRM, landscape 16:9, no interface. Create a beautiful restrained macro photographic view of crystalline clear flowing water, very pale powder blue, ice blue, aquamarine hints and silvery white. Organic broad ripples with depth, elegant refracted caustic light, smooth tranquil flowing directions, subtle realistic water texture. The entire scene should feel luminous, clean and spacious, with many quiet pale regions across the center to support dark readable dashboard text behind transparent glass panels. Gentle natural illumination, no hard hotspots or high frequency distracting patterns. Edge to edge water, no shore, no objects, no people, no text, no lettering, no logos, no UI. Premium understated material photography, not a flat gradient, not a swimming pool with tiles. Composition works as background cropped to desktop or portrait mobile. This will be slowly animated with a moving camera, so provide generous continuous water detail at all edges.
refinamento: Edit the provided crystalline water image for a premium light CRM background. Preserve the exact water composition, flowing ripple forms, caustics and natural photographic texture. Lower exposure and bright highlights noticeably: replace the washed-out pale white center with a slightly deeper, balanced soft blue, still a light theme. Richer powder blue and muted clear aquamarine, no blown white areas, a calm medium-light luminous value suitable behind dark readable dashboard text. Keep subtle sparkling caustic light without excessive glare. No additional objects, text or logos. Keep landscape 16:9 framing. Change only color/light intensity, not composition.
